thread:
Maria: Heads up — planning the social push for the May 18 webinar (Performance & Cost: Redwood Inference). Need X thread + LinkedIn carousel scheduled next Tuesday. Who can own assets + copy? :rocket:
Alex: I can own scheduling. What time window are we targeting? morning ET or afternoon?
Maria: Prefer 9–11am PT (noon ET) for X thread, noon PT for LinkedIn. Also want a follow-up engagement schedule (24h, 72h) with replies template.
Priya: I'll handle copy for X thread. Need event link + speaker headshots + 3 quotable stats. Can someone drop assets here?
Jamal: I can do carousel design. ETA EOD Monday. Will need final copy and logos.
Sam: I'll draft tweet thread. Quick thumbs-up on tone: product-first, benchmark-led, CTA to register.
Olivia: I'll prep UTM params and registration shortlink. Also recommend adding tracking pixel for paid boosts.
Priya: rough X thread draft:

```
1/ We're hosting a webinar: 'Performance & Cost: Running LLMs in Production' — May 18.
2/ Quick benchmark: same model, 3 quant profiles -> 2.4x cost reduction w/ ~5% latency change.
3/ We'll show live demo + rollout tips for Dedicated vs Hosted.
4/ Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=may_launch

RTs appreciated :pray:
```

Alex: Nice. For LinkedIn carousel, Jamal — can you make 5 slides: hook, benchmark, deployment modes, obs/tooling, CTA?
Jamal: yep. can you confirm slide copy length? 20–30 words each?
Priya: 25w max per slide. I'll create microcopy by EOD Mon.
Sam: Scheduling CSV for the queue (attached):

```
date,time,channel,copy,asset
2026-05-18,09:00,x,"tweet thread v1",assets/x-thread-v1.png
2026-05-18,12:00,linkedin,"carousel v1",assets/linkedin-carousel-v1.pdf
```

Olivia: tagging plan: @redwoodhq, speakers @jamie @lee, partner handles. Paid boost: small test $200 first 24h.
Maria: Great. Owners -> Alex (scheduling), Priya (copy), Jamal (design), Olivia (links/UTM), Sam (engagement replies). Can we do a quick check-in Tues AM?
Alex: Yes, scheduled check-in 10am PT Tue. I'll create calendar invite.
Priya: I'll post reply templates for follow-ups (30 char warm, 2 variations).
Sam: I'll queue engagement playbook: first-hour reactive replies, day-1 thread bump, day-3 CTA repost.
Maria: Perfect. If assets missed, escalate to @olivia. Thanks all :tada:
